newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Retail buying seen underpinning Singapore stocks.
newsitem.headline: Retail buying seen underpinning Singapore stocks.

text.p: Continued bottom-fishing of small-capitalised stocks by retail investors was seen underpinning Singapore stocks on Thursday, dealers said.
"The market has fallen a lot in recent weeks. For investors with a longer outlook, it's time to buy since you will never know where the bottom is," a dealer said.
However, chartists warned the key Straits Times Industrials (STI) index was looking vulnerable and could test further downside to around 2,006.
The STI index ended 17.52 points down at 2,023.86 on Wednesday while Wall Street eased 68.08 points to 7,689.98.
